mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(pay_method, '现金') AS payMethod, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM order_main WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('已付款', '已完成') AND DATE(order_time) = #{date} GROUP BY pay_method
SELECT COALESCE(pay_method, '现金') AS payMethod, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS amount FROM recharge_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = #{date} GROUP BY pay_method
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM purchase_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND purchase_date = #{date}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(final_amount, claim_amount, 0)), 0) FROM claim_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(COALESCE(pay_time, create_time)) = #{date}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_main WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('已付款', '已完成') AND DATE(order_time) = #{date}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recharge_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = #{date}

SELECT '商品' AS subject, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM order_main o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN ('已付款', '已完成') AND YEAR(o.order_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(o.order_time) = #{month} UNION ALL SELECT '充值' AS subject, COALESCE(SUM(r.pay_amount), 0) AS amount FROM recharge_record r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND YEAR(r.create_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(r.create_time) = #{month}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.cost * i.quantity), 0) FROM order_item i INNER JOIN order_main o ON i.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN ('已付款', '已完成') AND YEAR(o.order_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(o.order_time) = #{month}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM purchase_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND YEAR(purchase_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(purchase_date) = #{month}

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM order_main WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('已付款', '已完成') AND YEAR(order_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(order_time) = #{month}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM recharge_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(create_time) = #{month})

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM order_main WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('已付款', '已完成') AND YEAR(order_time) = #{year}-1 AND MONTH(order_time) = #{month}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM recharge_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year}-1 AND MONTH(create_time) = #{month})

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM order_main WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('已付款', '已完成') AND DATE(order_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM recharge_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate})

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM purchase_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND purchase_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(final_amount, claim_amount, 0)), 0) FROM claim_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(COALESCE(pay_time, create_time)) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate})

SELECT d.dt AS reportDate, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) FROM order_main o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN ('已付款', '已完成') AND DATE(o.order_time) = d.dt) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.pay_amount), 0) FROM recharge_record r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND DATE(r.create_time) = d.dt) AS amount FROM ( SELECT DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL seq DAY) AS dt FROM (SELECT a.N + b.N * 10 AS seq FROM (SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) a, (SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) b ) t WHERE DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL seq DAY) <= #{endDate} ) d ORDER BY d.dt

SELECT i.goods_name AS goodsName, COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS amount FROM order_item i INNER JOIN order_main o ON i.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN ('已付款', '已完成') AND DATE(o.order_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY i.goods_id, i.goods_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
